Maria H: Quick kickoff — CloudStack confirmed marketplace SKU for new eu-mad1 region but we need capacity carve + HW partner sign-off.
Tony P: Awesome. do we have exact SKU ids from CloudStack? can we list required quotas?
Nikita: They sent a CSV and a short note. main SKUs: CLOUD-LLM-GPU-1 (32GB A100 equiv), CLOUD-LLM-GPU-2 (48GB V100 equiv). quota ask: 40 units initial, 120 over 90d.
Sarah (ops): 40 units initial ok if accel partner can commit fallback pool. can we onboard AccelNode for baremetal in the same region?
Kai: talking to AccelNode now — they can supply 30 physical hosts at launch, plus 20 in a warmed standby (on 7d notice). that maps to ~85 GPU units depending on packing.
Maria H: Great. triple-check KMS + compliance requirements before marketplace listing. Claire, legal — anything special for Spain region?
Claire (Legal): Need vendor T&Cs OK with local data residency clause + standard marketplace revenue share. will review CloudStack contract, aim for sign-off by EOD Wed.
Ravi (Marketing): Timeline ask from partners: joint announcement window between May 8-12. We need final marketplace page + joint blog + tweet thread.
Tony P: Ops checklist: (1) quota provisioning request to CloudStack (2) AccelNode SLA + burn rate table (3) KMS integration + key export check (4) stage listing in staging marketplace.
Sarah (ops): I'll open the quota ticket today. snippet I'm using:
```
Request: eu-mad1 quotas
SKU: CLOUD-LLM-GPU-1 x40, CLOUD-LLM-GPU-2 x0
Purpose: initial marketplace launch + dedicated reserved pool
ETA: 2026-05-01
```
Nikita: AccelNode asked for expected throughput profile — 95th pct concurrent tokens, avg seq len 256, expected QPS 180 at peak. sending them a sample load profile now.
Kai: also flagging that runtime requires a specific kernel; AccelNode may need microcode update. will coordinate with their infra lead.
Maria H: Risk items: 1) marketplace listing delayed -> announcement slip 2) HW shortfall during promo -> fallback to hosted pool (need cross-account routing policy) 3) KMS not approved -> no private deployments at launch.
Tony P: For fallback, can eng set a routing policy that will route to `redwood-hosted-eu` if dedicated capacity < 15 units? @Kai can you evaluate complexity?
Kai: yes, doable. need ~2 days to add a new policy and test canary. recommend feature-flag rollout and smoke tests.
Claire (Legal): one more note — CloudStack requires us to display partner logo and a specific trademark line. Marketing ok with that @Ravi?
Ravi (Marketing): fine. will draft co-branded assets. propose internal dry run on May 3 and final sign-off May 6.
Maria H: Action owners: Sarah -> quotas ticket (today). Nikita -> confirm AccelNode capacity commitment + SLA (tomorrow). Claire -> contract review (EOD Wed). Kai -> routing/fallback plan + ETA (48h). Ravi -> announcement schedule + assets (May 3 dry run).
deploy-bot: notice: Staging marketplace page created at https://staging.cloudstack.example.com/redwood/eu-mad1 (id: stg-mlm-842)
Tony P: Perfect. we'll sync Friday 09:30 UTC to lock timeline. thanks all :thumbsup:
Nikita: I'll post AccelNode written confirmation here once I have it.
Maria H: Closing notes: prioritize KMS approval, without it we can't enable Private offering in region. keep comms if any blocking legal or infra.
Maria H: Thanks everyone — thread closed for now, follow ups as listed.
